## WQGuard v1.2.2 (Build 16)

全栈中英双语支持正式发布（解决 Issue #1 / Resolves #1）。

---

### English Release Notes

- **Full-Stack English Localization (`en` / `zh-Hans`)** (Resolves [#1](https://github.com/Kianuni/WQGuard/issues/1), thanks to `@i0ntempest`):
  - Fixed `WQStrings` explicit `.lproj` bundle lookup so English systems no longer fall back to `CFBundleDevelopmentRegion = zh-Hans`.
  - Localized all SwiftUI views and `ScanViewModel`, including the **Dashboard** active engine badge & queued `.ipa` summary, the entire **Scan Sources & Pairing** tutorial (`InstalledScanConfigSheet`), and the **IPA Scan** tab lower notes & queue controls (`IPAScanView`).
  - Localized `InfoPlist.strings` (`en` / `zh-Hans`, including `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription`).
  - Localized `WQGuardCore` (`WQLocale`, firmware CVE posture radar, detection indicators, remediation guidance, Lockdown/instproxy diagnostics, and proxy shield headers/comments bumped to `#!version=1.2.2`).
- **Verification**:
  - `swift test --disable-sandbox -Xswiftc -strict-concurrency=complete`: **685 tests passed, 0 failures** (`LocalizationBilingualTests`, `SurgeModuleTests`, `SecurityAuditV121RegressionTests`, etc.).

### 中文更新说明

- **全栈中英双语本地化（修复 [#1](https://github.com/Kianuni/WQGuard/issues/1)，感谢 `@i0ntempest` 反馈）**：
  - 修复 `WQStrings` 在 `CFBundleDevelopmentRegion = zh-Hans` 下部分英文键回退到简体中文的 `.lproj` 解析问题，并同步 `en.lproj` / `zh-Hans.lproj`（含 `InfoPlist.strings`）。
  - 完整本地化 **仪表盘活跃引擎计数角标与待扫 IPA 摘要**、**扫描源与无线配对完整教程页 (`InstalledScanConfigSheet`)**、**IPA 扫描底部说明与队列控制 (`IPAScanView`)**、设置页及 `ScanViewModel`。
  - 通过新增 `WQLocale` 完成 `WQGuardCore` 核心引擎全链路双语输出（固件漏洞雷达、风险指标描述与修复建议、配对/代理状态诊断及 5 端流量防护规则 `#!version=1.2.2`）。
- **测试验证**：
  - Swift 6 严格并发模式下完整测试套件执行 **685 项测试全部通过，0 失败**。

---

### Release Assets / 发布附件

- `WQGuard_v1.2.2.ipa` — Unsigned ad-hoc IPA (`v1.2.2`, Build 16) for iOS 16+ / 17+ / 18+ / 26+
- `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.sgmodule` — Surge
- `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.module` — Shadowrocket
- `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.conf` — Quantumult X
- `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.plugin` — Loon
- `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.stoverride` — Stash
